verdict.rationale: Claude documents a first-party API ("Build with the Claude API"), so programmatic access exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the consumer UI features (memory, Artifacts, scheduled tasks, shared workspaces, connectors, Design/Slides/Docs) are exposed through that API, so parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for UI features such as memory, Artifacts, task scheduling and workspaces; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec showing parity (the probe found none on the support site); independent or hands-on corroboration of API/UI feature parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Build with the Claude API and manage keys, usage, and billing in the Console.
